items.note: System paper (EnamelAI Painter for Canton porcelain painting) whose 19-person study compares it with existing AI and non-AI tools; reported outcomes are creative engagement and user experience, which may be self-reported only, so the full text must show whether outputs were scored.

PhD dissertation whose Study 1 is a quasi-experiment that varies LLM randomness during creative work and measures perceived creativity of the work (rater-based or self-perceived is unclear); Study 2 is AI-text detection and is out of scope; abstract from the MSU record page gives no sample size.

DesignAgent LLM multi-agent system for UAV landing-gear design, mostly evaluated on 104 simulated sessions; a user study against baseline systems reports higher design accuracy and solution quality, with human sample size not given and quality rather than novelty as the outcome.

Field experiment with students in which questioning-enhanced GenAI raised computed fluency, flexibility, and originality of ideas; the comparison condition (plain GenAI or no AI) and sample size are not stated in the abstract (ICIS 2025 proceedings).

User study (N=24) compares an LLM graph-reasoning whiteboard with a chat-only AI baseline (AI-configuration comparison) and finds higher engineering quality of final design schemes; below the 50-participant threshold.

System paper (stickynexus sticky-note interface for organizing GenAI output in design) with an 18-person user study; the comparison condition is not stated and the outcomes (information exploration, creative exploration) may be process or self-report measures.

Design-education workshop comparing student teams that used AI at the ideation stage with teams that used it at the storyboarding stage (AI-configuration comparison); the main measure is the Creativity Support Index (self-report), and it is unclear whether idea diversity was scored on outputs; abstract from the DRS landing page, sample size not given.

GPSdesign GenAI problem-solution co-evolution system compared with a baseline system for product conceptual design; reports greater design-space divergence and higher solution quality; sample size and baseline type (AI or not) not stated.

CHI 2025 system paper (CoExploreDS human-AI design-space exploration); user studies report significantly better design quality, but the comparison condition and sample size are not stated in the abstract.

Foundation-model approach to combinational creativity: a model-side comparison of generated ideas plus a user study comparing the CombinatorX tool with an existing combinational-creativity tool and internet search on idea-generation effectiveness; sample size not stated.
